intro.title: TanStack Query Basics
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React app that fetches and displays a list of posts from a mock API using TanStack Query. You will learn the core concept of server-state management, which handles fetching, caching, and updating data without manual state logic. The main technologies involved are React with TypeScript, the TanStack Query library (via @tanstack/react-query), and a mock API service. By the end, you'll understand how to set up a QueryClient, use the useQuery hook to fetch data, and display it in your components efficiently.
intro.usecase: TanStack Query is essential for building modern data-driven applications where real-time updates and efficient server state management are critical. You'll see this pattern in e-commerce product listings that need to stay synchronized with inventory, social media feeds that update with new posts, and dashboard analytics that refresh with live metrics. As a developer, you'll use TanStack Query to handle loading states, error handling, caching, and background refetching without manually managing complex state logic. This approach ensures users always see current data while maintaining optimal performance across network conditions.
